lol.champions.rune-advice.absolute-focus: Extra damage while at high health, which suits builds that lean into damage over utility.
lol.champions.rune-advice.absorb-life: A safe pick for extra survivability when poke is heavy or lane sustain is thin.
lol.champions.rune-advice.aftershock: Gives tank supports with crowd control enough resistances to survive their own engage.
lol.champions.rune-advice.approach-veloc: Move speed toward slowed and immobilized targets, so crowd control champions can close in and follow up.
lol.champions.rune-advice.arcane-comet: Good for ability-based champions that poke constantly and want lane priority.
lol.champions.rune-advice.biscuit-delive: Free biscuits add lane sustain, keeping farm steady through the laning phase.
lol.champions.rune-advice.bone-plating: Blunts incoming burst, buying survivability against burst champions.
lol.champions.rune-advice.cash-back: Refunds part of every Legendary item purchase, which speeds up the core build.
lol.champions.rune-advice.celerity: Helps move speed champions rotate quickly and hold better positioning.
lol.champions.rune-advice.cheap-shot: Adds damage against crowd-controlled targets, so assassins and carries get more out of every skirmish.
lol.champions.rune-advice.conditioning: Does nothing early, but adds real durability after 12 minutes, so it fits builds playing for late game.
lol.champions.rune-advice.conqueror: Effective for champions that weave abilities and autos through long fights, and against tank-heavy comps.
lol.champions.rune-advice.cosmic-insight: Summoner Spell and item haste for champions that lean on both.
lol.champions.rune-advice.coup-de-grace: Hits harder the lower the target's health, so one-sided fights close out faster.
lol.champions.rune-advice.cut-down: Deals more damage to high-health targets, which makes it effective against tanks and bruisers.
lol.champions.rune-advice.dark-harvest: Stacks from the early game, so burst champions looking for a one-shot hit their spike sooner.
lol.champions.rune-advice.deep-ward: Wards in the enemy jungle and the river last longer and take more to kill, effective for junglers and supports holding deep vision.
lol.champions.rune-advice.demolish: A good pick for tower-shredding champions looking for extra gold in the laning phase.
lol.champions.rune-advice.electrocute: Delivers a big chunk of burst, which suits assassins and champions built around short trades.
lol.champions.rune-advice.first-strike: Extra gold for strong pokers that scale, pulling their power spikes forward.
lol.champions.rune-advice.fleet-footwork: Adds lane sustain against heavy poke, and for melee champions matched into ranged ones.
lol.champions.rune-advice.font-of-life: Allies heal off crowd-controlled enemies, lifting the whole team's fighting power.
lol.champions.rune-advice.gathering-stor: Stats keep growing as the game runs long, which suits carries that want to take over late.
lol.champions.rune-advice.glacial-augmen: Locks targets down for supports with crowd control, opening kill windows in team fights.
lol.champions.rune-advice.grasp-of-the-u: Steady trades stack health and damage, which is good on bruisers and tanks.
lol.champions.rune-advice.grisly-memento: Stacking mementos in fights grants trinket haste, so vision control and fight impact grow together.
lol.champions.rune-advice.guardian: Shields an ally, helping enchanter supports come out ahead in trades.
lol.champions.rune-advice.hail-of-blades: Packs several autos into a moment, which suits hit-and-run champions that burst a target and back off.
lol.champions.rune-advice.hextech-flasht: Stands in for Flash on junglers and supports, adding map pressure and playmaking.
lol.champions.rune-advice.jack-of-all-tr: For builds that spread across many different item stats, turning that variety into adaptive force.
lol.champions.rune-advice.last-stand: Damage ramps up at low health, giving champions that get dived a way to fight back.
lol.champions.rune-advice.legend-alacrit: Suits auto-attack champions, since the bonus attack speed turns straight into damage.
lol.champions.rune-advice.legend-bloodli: Covers survivability for champions with no built-in healing or no lifesteal in the build.
lol.champions.rune-advice.legend-haste: A good pick for champions built around cooldowns that want abilities back up sooner.
lol.champions.rune-advice.lethal-tempo: Built for auto-attack champions that scale with attack speed, and strongest in extended fights.
lol.champions.rune-advice.magical-footwe: Free boots free up gold for the rest of the build.
lol.champions.rune-advice.manaflow-band: Grows max mana, so ability-hungry champions can lane without running dry.
lol.champions.rune-advice.nimbus-cloak: Move speed right after a Summoner Spell opens up kill threats and clean escapes.
lol.champions.rune-advice.nullifying-orb: Grants a magic damage shield for extra survivability against AP-heavy enemy comps.
lol.champions.rune-advice.overgrowth: Max health keeps climbing through the game, so the rune only gets better late.
lol.champions.rune-advice.phase-rush: The move speed after a combo lets immobile champions trade and get back out safely.
lol.champions.rune-advice.presence-of-mi: Suits ability-reliant champions that run out of mana and need to keep casting.
lol.champions.rune-advice.press-the-atta: Ramps up a burst of damage after three hits, so short trades and quick picks land harder.
lol.champions.rune-advice.relentless-hun: Good for junglers and supports that roam and gank, since the move speed carries them across the map.
lol.champions.rune-advice.revitalize: A good pick for champions with shields or heals, pushing those abilities further.
lol.champions.rune-advice.scorch: Adds chip damage to every poke, so ability-based champions win trades and skirmishes.
lol.champions.rune-advice.second-wind: A safe choice in poke-heavy lanes, healing back chip damage to hold lane sustain.
lol.champions.rune-advice.shield-bash: Turns a shield into a burst of extra damage for champions that can shield themselves in a fight.
lol.champions.rune-advice.sixth-sense: Reveals hidden wards automatically, useful for supports and junglers that fight for vision.
lol.champions.rune-advice.sudden-impact: Adds damage right after a dash or a stealth, which is effective on mobile assassins.
lol.champions.rune-advice.summon-aery: Suits champions that trade often with autos or abilities, and supports that buff allies.
lol.champions.rune-advice.taste-of-blood: Heals on trades and skirmishes, making it the safest way to add survivability.
lol.champions.rune-advice.time-warp-toni: Potions do more, so it pays off whenever the build drinks often.
lol.champions.rune-advice.transcendence: Ability haste that pays off for champions casting on every cooldown.
lol.champions.rune-advice.treasure-hunt: A safe choice for champions that want early gold to reach their spikes sooner.
lol.champions.rune-advice.triple-tonic: Free tonics at set levels speed up the early game.
lol.champions.rune-advice.triumph: Good when fights break out often, and for champions that already win them and want to stay in.
lol.champions.rune-advice.ultimate-hunte: Cuts ultimate cooldown so champions built around their ultimate can use it more often.
lol.champions.rune-advice.unflinching: Tenacity that makes enemy crowd control chains far easier to ride out.
lol.champions.rune-advice.unsealed-spell: Swapping Summoner Spells to fit the situation opens up strategic play.
lol.champions.rune-advice.waterwalking: Good for junglers and supports that live around the river, for the move speed and bonus stats.

valorant.aim-review.insights.accurateHig: Your clean shot rate is {{accurateRate}}%. Your stopping and fight-finishing mechanics are already at a high level.
valorant.aim-review.insights.accurateLow: Your clean shot rate is {{accurateRate}}%, which is relatively low. Focus on improving your stopping timing and maintaining proper crosshair placement.
valorant.aim-review.insights.brakeMiss: You had {{brakeMissedCount}} counter-strafing misses. Even if your aim is on target, failing to stop properly can throw off your shots. Try delaying your first shot slightly after spotting an enemy to reduce fight losses.
valorant.aim-review.insights.cadenceErra: Your shot pacing is erratic (high cadence variance). Tapping with a steady rhythm that lets first-shot accuracy reset will tighten your spread.
valorant.aim-review.insights.fallback: You had limited fights or inconsistent shooting patterns. Review your rounds and look for repeated first-shot habits to improve.
valorant.aim-review.insights.firstShotLo: Your first-shot accuracy is {{firstShotAccurateRate}}%. In VALORANT the opening bullet usually decides the duel—pre-aiming each angle at head height will raise your first-shot win rate more than anything else.
valorant.aim-review.insights.headAbove: Your crosshair is often placed above head level. Lowering your crosshair slightly will improve your first-shot accuracy.
valorant.aim-review.insights.headBelow: Your crosshair is often placed below head level. Try keeping your crosshair about half a step higher before taking fights.
valorant.aim-review.insights.movingPenal: Your accuracy drops {{accuracyMovingPenalty}}%p when firing on the move versus stopped. Committing to a full stop (counter-strafe) before shooting will recover most of that loss.
valorant.aim-review.insights.overshoot: You tend to overshoot your target after spotting enemies. After large flicks, avoid shooting immediately—make a small adjustment before firing. (If your aim feels inconsistent, it could be a sensitivity issue. Try using the sensitivity finder overlay.)
valorant.aim-review.insights.reactionSlo: Your median reaction (enemy appears → first shot) is {{reactionMedianMs}}ms, which is on the slow side for in-game play. Pre-aiming angles lets you fire sooner without relying on raw reaction.
valorant.aim-review.insights.title: Aim Insights
valorant.aim-review.insights.undershoot: You often undershoot and stop short of your target. Try committing slightly more to your flick to land accurately. (If your aim feels inconsistent, it could be a sensitivity issue. Try using the sensitivity finder overlay.)
